text: I can pick a timeout from a downstream's client-side latency percentiles and an accepted false-timeout rate, and use Little's law to show how many threads a slow dependency would hold.
I can propagate a deadline across four hops, subtracting each hop's work and a safety margin, and fail fast when the remaining budget cannot fit a call.
I can write the exact full-jitter formula and compute the sleep window and average for any attempt, base and cap.
I can compute retry amplification across layers (k^L) and show how a 10% retry budget caps worst-case load at 1.1×.
I can list which failures not to retry and explain why retrying a non-idempotent call after a timeout needs an idempotency key stored atomically with the effect.
